free_resources.title: A Body Scan Meditation to Prepare Mind and Body for Sleep
free_resources.description: A free guided body scan led by mindfulness educator Diana Winston, for evenings when it is hard to wind down. Attention moves slowly through the body to let the day's tension settle before sleep. Script and audio on Mindful's site.

free_resources.title: A Meditation for Easing Pain and Inviting Joy
free_resources.description: A gentle guided practice from teacher Vanessa Hutchinson-Szekely, shaped by her own long spell of back pain. It invites resting with discomfort through breath and soft attention rather than fighting it, and leaves room for moments of joy. Free script and audio.

free_resources.title: A Meditation to Bring Comfort and Kindness to Pain and Illness
free_resources.description: A free imaginative meditation from teacher Juliana Sloane for people living with ongoing pain or illness. It uses relaxation and visualisation to meet discomfort with patience and self-compassion. Script and audio on Mindful's site.
